aggregate.interpretation: Unique saved-activation storages retained only because each storage is below the 32-MiB coarse threshold are a lower-reuse candidate than repeatedly materialized frozen blocks. The separate pack-byte counter includes aliases and must not be treated as physical GPU capacity. Even the deduplicated volume is not proof that all bytes are simultaneously releasable at the OOM peak.

phase_delta_attribution.note: Phase deltas are simultaneous allocator observations and avoid adding peaks. The persistent floor is not classified as redundant.

unclassified.note: Model residency and unique kept saved-activation storage are subtracted only at the pre-backward boundary. Remaining bytes can include buffers, checkpoint boundaries, outputs, temporaries, workspaces, continuous state, or accounting uncertainty. No residual is labelled redundant.
